title.zh: 在苏禄省设立公路工程分区的法案
title.en: An Act to Create a Highway Engineering Sub-District in the Province of Sulu
title.orig: An Act to Create a Highway Engineering Sub-District in the Province of Sulu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4407_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law, executive order or administrative regulation to the contrary notwithstanding, the portion of the Province of Sulu comprising the Island of Siasi and all other islands south of Siasi is hereby constituted into a highway engineering sub-district under an assistant highway district engineer and under the direct supervision of the highway district engineer.

The Commissioner of Public Highways shall, within thirty days from the approval of this Act, organize the highway engineering sub-district in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act Numbered One thousand one hundred and ninety-two.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
